description: Corpus evaluation thresholds. Failing any gate causes CI to fail.

micro_precision.description: Minimum micro-average precision across all positive cases. Milestone 1 target: 75%.

macro_precision.description: Minimum macro-average precision across per-language averages.

micro_recall.description: Minimum micro-average recall. Cannot drop below 95% without suppressing legitimate findings.

negative_accuracy.description: Negative-case accuracy must not fall below current 91.67% (11/12).

maximum_regression.description: Maximum allowed regression from the previous baseline stored in results.json.

enforcement.description: Do not default missing metrics to a passing value. Missing or malformed results fail the gate.
